content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Describe the structure of arteries, veins, and capillaries
Explain how blood vessel structure relates to function
Compare the features of different blood vessels
Describe how substances are exchanged at capillaries
are tubes that carry blood around the body. There are three main types: arteries, veins, and capillaries. Each type has a structure suited to its function in the circulatory system.
